audit_phase: AQ-01R (rerun of AQ-01 after AQ-02A remediation)
audit_type: Google AdSense & Content Quality Certification Audit
scope_note: Same methodology and scoring rubric as AQ-01, applied unchanged. Every score below was re-derived by re-reading live pages after AQ-02A, not carried forward from the original audit or estimated from AQ-02A's own completion report.
sample_basis: Re-opened the same representative sample as AQ-01: the 7 AQ-02A success-criteria pages, the same group/category hubs, the same dish pages, the same wine-education-tier pages, plus direct inspection of sitemap.xml, all 11 domain-hub paths, and the catalog fields behind each.

original_value.basis: 1,252 leaf/group/category pages across all 11 food domains now open with genuine, entity-specific authored prose instead of a bare fact table — verified directly on marionberry, chanterelle, berbere, buckwheat, almond, chimichurri, and (in dist/, unpublished) akawi. The wine-education tier (~430 pages), unchanged, remains the site's richest content. Score held below Silver-band because most narrative content is still brief (typically one sentence) and beginner_notes/FAQ depth is authored for only ~35% of leaf entities (protein and cheese).

helpful_content.basis: Every ingredient page now teaches a concrete pairing rationale naming specific wines, a real improvement on 'would a cook learn something.' Held back by: content still brief per entity, site search still excludes all food-ontology pages (unchanged), and preparation-specific guidance remains largely absent outside protein/cheese.

eeat_signals.basis: One accuracy defect resolved as a side effect: cheese pages no longer render a 'Scientific name' field populated with the source animal's species (that field was replaced by 'Milk source' in the new template) — confirmed absent from dist/cheeses/akawi/. Unresolved: the béarnaise/coconut relationship not traceable to its own catalog data is still live, and — because it now renders under a real 'Common Culinary Uses' heading instead of a bare unlabeled list — is arguably more visible to a reader than before. Unsupported 'Pairing Strength: XX%' scores, 51 undisclosed duplicate legacy pages, and the Disclaimer/Organization-schema jurisdiction inconsistency are all unchanged.

thin_content.basis: The dominant AQ-01 finding — TC-01 (956 leaf pages, zero prose) and TC-03 (72 group/category hubs, zero prose) — is resolved: verified zero empty-section violations and 1,252/1,252 authored summaries rendering, per AQ-02A's own QA pass, independently spot-checked here. TC-02 (51 duplicate deprecated protein pages) is technically resolved in the sense that both the deprecated and canonical versions now carry narrative, though the underlying duplicate-URL problem is untouched (see entity_quality and navigation_quality). Remaining thin content — seasonal guides (TC-04), region pages beyond /regions/usa/ (TC-05), serving pages (TC-06) — is entirely in the wine-education tier and confirmed unchanged, re-read directly.

template_detection.basis: Leaf-tier structural DOM similarity across ~1,000 pages is unavoidable and unchanged (a clean shared layout, not inherently a defect per AQ-01's own framing), but the sentence-level content inside that structure is now genuinely unique per entity rather than absent — substantially reducing the 'reads like scaled/auto-generated content' signal for the majority-by-count tier. Entirely unchanged and re-confirmed: the wine-descriptor-category 'Understanding X descriptors helps you...' noun-swap template, and the leftover-template-variable phrase 'is the best if the dish is smoky for X' still live verbatim on wine-with-grilled-steak.html and wine-with-smoked-pork.html.

pairing_quality.basis: The single most-cited AQ-01 defect in this category — a bare, unexplained 'Primary wine styles' link list — no longer exists on any of the ~1,166 leaf pages; each now carries a rationale sentence immediately above the categorized style/technique links, verified on multiple entities including sauce-condiment's differentiated pairing taxonomy (chimichurri: primary/classic/contrasting/regional/avoid). Dish-specific guides (unchanged) remain the strongest single content class on the site. Held back from a higher score by: pairing rationale is still one sentence per entity, not dish-specific to preparation the way the dish guides are, and the unsupported 'Pairing Strength %' pattern on dish pages is unchanged.

entity_quality.basis: One data-accuracy defect (cheese scientific-name mislabeling) no longer renders, resolved as a side effect of the template change rather than a data fix. Every other AQ-01 accuracy finding — chayote misclassified under root-vegetables, the boldo/pork-loin plausibility flag, the fava-bean grammar defect in the authored summary, the béarnaise/coconut unsourced relationship — is unchanged, confirmed by re-checking the same catalog entries; these are appropriately out of AQ-02A's publication-layer scope.

internal_linking.basis: Root sitemap.xml now references 10 of 11 food-domain sitemap sets (previously 1 of 11) — confirmed by direct inspection — a meaningful, if incidental, crawl-discoverability improvement. The Wine Pairing Explanation section also groups related links under contextual sub-headings instead of a flat list, a minor linking-quality improvement. The dominant defect from AQ-01 — every page's link back to its own domain root pointing at a 404 — is completely unchanged; this caps the score.

navigation_quality.basis: Re-confirmed directly: all 11 food-domain hub paths (/foods/, /fruits/, etc.) still 404 on every published leaf/group/category page's main-nav 'Foods' link and breadcrumb root crumb. Site search still indexes only wine-side entities. The /terms.html vs /terms/ naming collision and the missing true glossary index are both unchanged. The small uptick reflects the sitemap improvement bleeding into general discoverability, not any change to on-site navigation itself.

adsense_readiness.basis: The single riskiest pattern identified in AQ-01 — a majority of live pages reading as unexplained, auto-assembled fact tables, the closest match to AdSense's 'scaled/low-value content' policy language — is resolved for the ~1,252 pages it affected. That was the largest, but not the only, risk factor: a reviewer who clicks the still-404ing 'Foods' nav link, or notices the still-dead 'View Bottle' buttons on dish pages, or the 51 still-undisclosed duplicate legacy pages, would still flag the site. See adsense-readiness.md for the full updated policy walk-through.

overall_tier_after: Bronze (upper band, close to the Silver threshold)

tier_scale.platinum: 90-100 — comprehensive, original, consistently authoritative across the whole site
tier_scale.silver: 60-74 — solid core content, systemic gaps in a minority of the site
tier_scale.bronze: 40-59 — a genuine editorial core exists but is outnumbered or undermined by thin/broken content across the majority of the site
tier_scale.not_certified: 0-39 — thin/templated/broken content is the dominant visible experience

tier_note: 38 -> 54 is real, verified movement (not a re-estimate) driven almost entirely by Thin Content (+50) and AdSense Readiness (+18), i.e. exactly the category AQ-02A targeted. It stays in Bronze rather than crossing into Silver because Navigation Quality (+2) and Internal Linking (+8) — the two categories governing whether a reviewer can orient themselves on the site at all — were outside AQ-02A's scope and remain close to where AQ-01 found them. Closing the domain-hub 404s and the wine-only search gap (see navigation-review.md and recommended-improvements.md) is now the highest-leverage remaining lever, on the same logic AQ-01 used originally: it is a mechanical, scoped fix, not a rewrite.
would_pass_manual_adsense_review_today: Still no, but for a narrower and more specific reason than before. The 'majority of pages are unexplained fact tables' risk that dominated the original verdict is resolved. The remaining risk is that a reviewer's very first orientation action (clicking the main-nav category link) 404s on every one of ~1,166 pages, which reads as basic operational incompleteness regardless of how good the content next to it has become. See adsense-readiness.md.
